stem: Based on the descriptions of Barkitecture doghouses in the selection, what can the reader conclude about the people who build them?

options.label: A
options.text: They are encouraged to be creative when designing their structures.

options.label: B
options.text: They have to learn the correct way to design doghouses.

options.label: C
options.text: They think that their doghouses are worth more than people are willing to pay.
